authorization.authorization_basis: user-directed extension of the completed LTX-2.3 versus Seedance 2.0 public-only quality screen to Gemini Omni Flash and MiniMax H3

scientific_distinction.shared_source_of_truth: the four frozen public-only scenes, exact compiled LTX prompts, paired LTX audio, and hash-verified LTX and Seedance media
scientific_distinction.new_question: Do Gemini Omni Flash or MiniMax H3 show a clear task-specific qualitative advantage over LTX-2.3, and are they competitive with Seedance 2.0, on the same four frozen public-only scenes?

allowed: the four self-authored public-only episode plans in the completed pilot
the exact compiled LTX prompts from the completed pilot
the completed public-only LTX and Seedance media
the completed public-only modular German audio
Gemini Omni Flash and MiniMax H3 outputs and engineering manifests produced only from those public inputs
prohibited: ChildLens or BabyView transcripts, filenames, identifiers, vocabulary, prompts, statistics, embeddings, or other derivatives
restricted or private paths, credentials, or personal identifiers in API payloads or persisted records
privacy_boundary.provider_download_policy: download immediately after each successful generation; keep provider URLs only in the ignored run root
privacy_boundary.credential_storage: environment only; never print or persist API keys

seedance.label: Seedance 2.0 standard
seedance.seed_control: unsupported; provider-returned seeds are retained in the completed result

gemini_omni_flash.label: Gemini Omni Flash Preview
gemini_omni_flash.input_seed_control: not documented for Gemini Omni Flash video generation; no seed is sent

minimax_h3.label: MiniMax H3
minimax_h3.input_seed_control: unsupported by the official MiniMax H3 V2 schema; no seed is sent

comparison.native_audio_policy: discard both new providers' native audio; every comparison final uses the exact AAC audio stream from its paired LTX final
comparison.delivery_policy: scale and center-crop every new output to 1280x704, normalize to 24 fps and 121 frames, then stream-copy the paired LTX audio
comparison.reference_media_policy: reuse and hash-verify the completed LTX and Seedance finals; do not regenerate either reference family
comparison.blinding: randomize all four family cards independently within each scene from the work-order hash and keep the family key outside the gallery

review.profile: single-rater four-family blinded qualitative screening; exploratory and not a formal model ranking

secondary_presentation_items.question: Does the visible image avoid unintended pseudo-caption text, intrusive logos, or provider branding that interferes with qualitative use?
Is the frame fully and coherently composed without unintended bars, malformed borders, or severe cropping?

review.speech_exclusion_reason: Every final uses the exact paired LTX AAC stream, so speech is an identity control and is excluded from visual comparison rules.
review.cannot_judge_policy: Report cannot-judge counts; a pairwise scene with unequal judgeable primary-item counts is inconclusive and cannot count as a win or tie.

provider_cost.failed_or_moderated_request_billing: provider-dependent; no automatic or protocol retry is authorized

governance.selection_rule: A qualitative win may inform later provider selection, but cannot authorize learner-training use by itself.
